_comment: Two interpolation surfaces live in this file. (1) Generator-time: tokens like Data Backup Manager are uppercase-snake-case placeholders replaced by `vrooli scenario generate` before the scenario is built — they appear as literal display values at runtime. (2) Runtime: tokens like {{count}} are i18next interpolation, replaced by `t(key, { count })` at render time. Keys that start with an underscore (like this one) are sentinels — skipped by the codegen, parity test, and unused-key audit.

drills.subtitle: Prove that protected snapshots can be restored without touching live data.
drills.emptyHint: Create a backup plan, then run a scratch-only recovery drill.
drills.evidenceHint: Drill results remain durable and link to the verified-restore evidence.

posture.title: Backup posture
posture.allClear: All targets protected and within cap

overview.title: Overview
overview.subtitle: Backup and verified-restore posture across everything this platform protects.
overview.coverageEmpty: No targets are being backed up yet.
overview.setupBody: Create an encrypted destination, then a plan that binds your targets to it. The first verified restore proves the backup actually works.
overview.metricsDedupEmpty: On-disk cost not measured yet — run a backup to see dedup.

discovery.title: Suggestions
discovery.subtitle: Things worth protecting and places to back up to, discovered on this machine.
discovery.onboardingBody: We scanned this machine and found things worth backing up. Enable a target and a destination to begin — the first verified restore proves it actually works.
discovery.targetsEmpty: No new sources to suggest — everything found is already registered.
discovery.destinationsEmpty: No writable volumes found to suggest as destinations.
discovery.readinessUnavailable: Couldn't check this destination. Nothing has been changed.
discovery.unsafe: Overlaps protected data — can't be used
discovery.moreAvailable: More suggestions are available after reviewing these.

coverage.title: Backup coverage
coverage.liveDescription: Coverage is evaluated live from registered targets and backup history.
coverage.incompleteBody: {{count}} recommended durable target(s) discovered on this machine are not registered yet. Register them so a plan can protect them.
coverage.complete: Default coverage complete — every recommended durable target is registered.
coverage.sensitiveBody: {{count}} discovered target(s) include credentials or tokens. They are never registered by default — review and enable them deliberately.
coverage.incompleteRejected: This plan was blocked because recommended default coverage is incomplete. Register the recommended targets, or proceed with incomplete coverage.

targets.subtitle: Runtime state registered for backup. Scenarios usually register themselves; you can also add or remove targets here.
targets.emptyHint: Scenarios register their own targets. You can also register one manually.
targets.ownerHint: The scenario or service that owns this state (e.g. prompt-manager).
targets.name: Name
targets.locatorHint: Path or glob, database name, key prefix, collection, or bucket — interpreted by kind. Never a secret.
targets.criticalHint: Approve this target for critical-primary and critical-secondary plans only after reviewing its recovery importance.
targets.deregisterBody: Removes {{name}} from the catalog. Existing snapshots in destinations are kept.
targets.noRestores: No restore or verify runs for this target yet.

destinations.subtitle: Encrypted kopia repositories your backups are written to. Passphrases and keys live in vault — never here.
destinations.emptyHint: Add an encrypted destination before you can create a backup plan.
destinations.name: Name
destinations.nameHint: A short, slug-safe name (lowercase letters, digits, hyphens). It is also the kopia repository name.
destinations.locationHint: The destination folder (bundle root) for a filesystem backend, or an S3 URI. Must not live under the data this manager protects.
destinations.capHint: 0 means no cap. Backups are never silently deleted to stay under it.
destinations.editLockedHint: Backend and location are fixed once the repository exists; only the cap is editable.
destinations.deleteRepo: Also remove local kopia metadata and vault secret references
destinations.deleteRepoHint: The encrypted repository bytes on the backend are never deleted by this action. Remove the bundle folder manually to destroy the backups.
destinations.nameInvalid: Use lowercase letters, digits and hyphens only (e.g. elements-local).
destinations.repositoryPathPreview: Kopia repository will be created at

plans.subtitle: Bind targets to destinations on a schedule with a retention policy. The scheduler runs each plan on its cadence; you can also run one now.
plans.emptyHint: A plan needs at least one target and one destination. Add a destination and register a target first.
plans.name: Name
plans.scheduleHint: Cron expression, e.g. 0 2 * * * for nightly at 02:00.
plans.recoveryDrillScheduleHint: Positive duration such as 168h. Empty means operator-triggered only.
plans.keepLatestHint: How many snapshots to retain per target. 0 keeps all.

runs.subtitle: Every plan execution, newest first. Expand a run to see its per-target outcomes.
runs.emptyHint: Trigger a plan from the Plans page, or wait for the scheduler.

restores.subtitle: Prove a backup restores (verify), or write it back to a location (restore). A verify is non-destructive and encouraged.
restores.emptyHint: Once a plan has run, verify a snapshot to prove it's restorable.
restores.chooseSnapshotHint: Snapshots come from successful runs. Pick one to verify or restore.
restores.noSnapshots: No snapshots available yet. Run a plan first.
restores.verifyHint: Test-restores to scratch and checksums it. Non-destructive.
restores.locationHint: Absolute path the snapshot will be written to.
restores.restoreConfirmBody: Writes {{target}} from snapshot {{snapshot}} to {{location}}. This overwrites data at that location.

audits.verdictPass: Passed — restored snapshot matches live by all generic signals.
audits.verdictDrift: Differences explained by drift — live changed after the snapshot.
audits.verdictDiff: Differences found — live is not newer than the snapshot. Investigate.

errors.internal: Something went wrong. Please try again.

errorBoundary.title: Something went wrong
errorBoundary.message: An unexpected error occurred while rendering the page. Try again, or reload if the problem persists.
